text_block_list.text:
"On the way back from an interview in 
Racewear, as I walked down the hallway 
with Grass Wonder, I suddenly noticed 
something."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer? Is something the matter~?
choice_data_list:
The logo on your ears and the one on your 
chest match, huh.

The logo on your ears and the one on your 
chest match, don't they?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you have a keen eye. That's right, 
it's actually the exact same mark~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Actually, you see~ If you look at it from 
the side, it's a "G"~

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my... Sei-chan, really~ How long have 
you been listening~?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Hey, more importantly, does that reaction 
mean I'm right~? To be honest, I was 
actually a bit curious about that too~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Since it's 'G,' maybe it's an initial? Or 
maybe 'Graceful,' since she's so ladylike?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Well now, I wonder about that~

Seiun Sky continued to press her after 
that, but she kept dodging the questions 
until the very end.

Still wondering about the answer, the next 
day arrived. As I waited for her for 
training—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Good morning~, Trainer. Hehe, what's with 
that serious look on your face?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Ah, is that what you mean~?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, I was just a bit embarrassed. I 
should have just told you the right 
answer~.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"Just as Sei-chan said, it's for my 
initial and 'Graceful'—the 'G' in 
graceful."

A graceful Yamato Nadeshiko—precisely 
because I knew she was more than that, 
something kept nagging at me.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...And the truth is?
choice_data_list:
There's another meaning to it, isn't 
there?
Doesn't it have another meaning too?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...And the truth is?
choice_data_list:
There's another meaning to it, isn't 
there?
Isn't there another meaning to it, too?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Um...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu, spot on. As expected of you~.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Still... it truly is a pleasure when 
someone realizes there's another meaning 
to it.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, that's enough of that topic. 
Let's get right into training~.

Saying so, she briskly headed toward the 
grounds... but suddenly stopped in her 
tracks and looked back.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"...Just one last thing. I'm the type who 
likes to wear my precious feelings on 
me~."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Someday, I will definitely... "acquire" 
victory. So please, continue to look after 
me.

She claimed a spectacular, commanding 
victory in next week's race. Seeing her 
race forward toward victory, I firmly 
resolved to keep supporting her from here 
on out.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, that's right... you got it~. I 
just added it.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"I poured something very precious into it, 
so 'Green Tea' isn't necessarily wrong 
either."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Still... to think you put so much thought 
into just a logo... It makes me happy. 
Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
So... this is special, just for you, 
Trainer. ...Keep it a secret from everyone 
else, okay?

Smiling as she said that, she secretly 
whispered a single word into my ear.

In the following week's race, she pulled 
off an impressive, hard-fought victory.

An 'indomitable spirit' obsessed with 
winning. I renewed my resolve to be a 
partner who can stay by her side and 
support that passion.
